rows.label: tlk70000061_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Rita got lost while we were exploring.
It ended safely, which was fortunate,
but...

rows.label: tlk70000061_03_msg0002
rows.name:
"I'm sorry if being my Blade means
you won't get to live very long."

rows.label: tlk70000061_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Rita said that, and I really got
angry.

rows.label: tlk70000061_03_msg0004
rows.name:
No... perhaps I was sad. I didn't want
her to think I sought Rita's strength
just so I could live longer.

rows.label: tlk70000061_03_msg0005
rows.name:
The time we spend together is
everything to me now. I don't simply
want to prolong my life.

rows.label: tlk70000061_03_msg0006
rows.name:
I wish I'd had another way to say it
without anger. I still have much to
learn myself.
